coverage.queryTemplate:
with physical as materialized (
  select cvv.variant_id, cvv.printing_id, cvv.set_id, cvv.language_code,
         cvv.catalogue_version_id
  from catalog.catalogue_version_variants cvv
  join catalog.card_variants v on v.id=cvv.variant_id
    and v.deprecated_at is null and v.language_code=cvv.language_code
    and v.printing_id=cvv.printing_id
  join catalog.card_printings p on p.id=cvv.printing_id
    and p.deprecated_at is null and p.set_id=cvv.set_id
    and p.language_code=cvv.language_code
  join catalog.sets s on s.id=p.set_id
    and s.deprecated_at is null and s.language_code=cvv.language_code
  join catalog.languages l on l.code=cvv.language_code
  where cvv.catalogue_version_id = :catalogue_version_id
    and cvv.language_code = :language_code
), assessed as (
  select c.*,
    exists (select 1 from market.catalogue_general_prices g
      where g.variant_id=c.variant_id and g.printing_id=c.printing_id
        and g.set_id=c.set_id and g.language_code=c.language_code
        and g.catalogue_version_id=c.catalogue_version_id) as tcgcsv_saved,
    exists (select 1 from market.catalogue_general_prices g
      where g.variant_id=c.variant_id and g.printing_id=c.printing_id
        and g.set_id=c.set_id and g.language_code=c.language_code
        and g.catalogue_version_id=c.catalogue_version_id
        and g.stale_after > now()) as tcgcsv_fresh,
    exists (select 1 from market.cardmarket_blended_general_prices cm
      where cm.printing_id=c.printing_id
        and cm.catalogue_version_id=c.catalogue_version_id) as cardmarket_saved,
    exists (select 1 from market.cardmarket_blended_general_prices cm
      where cm.printing_id=c.printing_id
        and cm.catalogue_version_id=c.catalogue_version_id
        and cm.stale_after > now()) as cardmarket_fresh
  from physical c
)
select :language_code as language_code, now() as observed_at, count(*) as physical_total,
 count(*) filter(where tcgcsv_saved) as tcgcsv_saved,
 count(*) filter(where tcgcsv_fresh) as tcgcsv_fresh,
 count(*) filter(where cardmarket_saved) as cardmarket_saved,
 count(*) filter(where cardmarket_fresh) as cardmarket_fresh,
 count(*) filter(where tcgcsv_saved or cardmarket_saved) as combined_saved,
 count(*) filter(where tcgcsv_fresh or cardmarket_fresh) as combined_fresh
from assessed;
